parent_objective: design a source-diverse low-margin normal-boundary corpus refresh

public_gates: M800 designs only; it does not implement or train
M800 preserves the P0 human-view actor contract
M800 targets source-diverse low-margin normal-boundary coverage
M800 caps the known active public source instead of optimizing only it
M800 blocks residual calibration, PPO, and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not implement the corpus miner
do not run closed-loop replay as a result claim
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not weaken low-margin source-diversity thresholds
do not tune only seed 77025 source_index 12
do not use private holdout failures to tune the public corpus

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves from single-source active-boundary blocker to a planned source-diverse low-margin corpus refresh
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no corpus implementation training PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design still depends on the single public active source as the only guard evidence
stop if it cannot define measurable source-diversity acceptance criteria
stop if it uses oracle deploy-time inputs
stop if it admits residual calibration before corpus coverage is refreshed
fallback_plan: if no low-margin rows can be found with the current scenario generator, broaden fault and obstacle sampling
if only one fault-family pair appears, retarget the scenario distribution before calibration
if the active source remains dominant, cap its contribution and report coverage failure
if the refresh succeeds, route to low-margin corpus refresh implementation before any calibrator training
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M799 pivots the branch from residual calibration tuning to corpus coverage

hypothesis: A dedicated source-diverse low-margin corpus refresh can provide enough near-boundary normal rows to fairly test active-steer residual guarding without overfitting to the single public active source.
success_criteria: M800 documents a no-training corpus refresh design
M800 specifies measurable row, seed, source_index, fault-family, and dominance gates
M800 specifies outputs for candidates, accepted rows, and summary
M800 preserves actor and residual-head input contracts
M800 keeps residual calibration, PPO, and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: design weakens the M798 source-diversity blocker
design lacks measurable corpus acceptance targets
design uses private holdout feedback for public tuning
design admits training, PPO, or promotion
decision_rule: M800 may only design a source-diverse low-margin corpus refresh. It must not implement the miner, train parameters, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
